# Separator

`ui.separator` · parts: `Separator` · elements: `<hr>`

## Purpose

Separator is the native <hr> (implicit role=separator). Vertical adds
aria-orientation; Decorative removes the semantics with role=none.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- `<hr>` already has the implicit role `separator` (horizontal), so a horizontal separator renders
  no ARIA at all.
- `orientation="vertical"` adds `aria-orientation="vertical"` (only for vertical; horizontal is the
  implicit default). Style the vertical line yourself, e.g. `class="h-6 border-l border-border"`.
- **Decorative**: `decorative` renders `role="none"` and drops `aria-orientation`. Chosen over
  `aria-hidden="true"`: the element is purely presentational, so removing its *semantics*
  (`none`, allowed on `hr` by ARIA in HTML) is the precise statement; `aria-hidden` would hide a
  node that has no content anyway and is meant for content-bearing elements.
- Void element: no children. Colors only via tokens (`border-border`), spacing on the 8+4 grid
  (`my-4`, `mx-2`).
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Separator renders a void hr; no children.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Orientation` | `orientation` | `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | — | prop | horizontal (default) \| vertical |
| `Decorative` | `decorative` | `decorative` | `boolean` | — | prop | purely visual: role=none, no separator semantics |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins).

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Void / self-contained element: children are not accepted.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `role`, `aria-orientation` (omitted when empty).

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<hr>` |
| horizontal | `{"Class":"my-4 border-border"}` | `<hr class="my-4 border-border">` |
| vertical | `{"Orientation":"vertical","Class":"mx-2 h-6 border-l border-border"}` | `<hr class="mx-2 h-6 border-l border-border" aria-orientation="vertical">` |
| decorative | `{"Decorative":true,"Orientation":"vertical","Class":"border-border"}` | `<hr class="border-border" role="none">` |
| Orientation=horizontal | `{"Orientation":"horizontal"}` | `<hr>` |
| Orientation=vertical | `{"Orientation":"vertical"}` | `<hr aria-orientation="vertical">` |
| Decorative | `{"Decorative":true}` | `<hr role="none">` |

## Usage

Fixture `horizontal` (`{"Class":"my-4 border-border"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<hr class="my-4 border-border">
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Separator } from "./ui/separator/separator";

<Separator className="my-4 border-border" />
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Separator from "./ui/separator/Separator.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Separator class="my-4 border-border" />
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))
